duration.text: The Materials Processing Engineering at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3402 USD/per year ￥ 24500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Only for applicants who wish to apply for Chinese-medium courses. 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 7. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 8. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency.

requirements.text: 1. Under the age of 40 2. Hold a Bachelor degree or equicalent qualification 3. Have a good command of English 4. In good health
